questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Cross Product of Two Vectors Whose Angle Is a Non-Special Angle
questions.problem: The vector $u$ has magnitude $8$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $2,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${100}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to one decimal place where appropriate.
questions.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|u|\cdot |v|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =8\cdot 2\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{100}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =16\cdot (0.984\,80…)\cdot n \\  & =(15.756\,92…)\cdot n \\  & ≈15.8n.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Cross Product of Two Parallel Vectors
questions.problem: The vector $a$ has magnitude $5,$ the vector $b$ has magnitude $2,$ and $a∥b.$ Find $a\times b.$
questions.worked_solution:
Suppose $a$ and $b$ are nonzero vectors. Then, $a\times b=0$ if and only if $a∥b.$

Therefore, $a\times b=0.$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Cross Product of Two Parallel Vectors
questions.problem: The vector $z$ has magnitude $2.$ What is $z\times z?$
questions.worked_solution:
Suppose $a$ and $b$ are nonzero vectors. Then, $a\times b=0$ if and only if $a∥b.$

Notice that any vector is parallel to itself. So, we have $z∥z.$

Therefore, $z\times z=0.$
